projects.name: GPD Property & Evidence Building
projects.funding_note: Capital Improvement Revenue Note, Series 2025 (bank loan secured by SSSF surtax revenue; agenda 2025-958, Dec 4 2025): $21,500,000 to the project + $62,000 Non-Departmental line in the note fund (inferred issuance cost). Plus SSSF surtax pay-go $615,980.73. The FY26 debt-service transfer of $2,908,110 from the surtax fund is not counted.
projects.address: SW corner of NW 6th St and NW 8th Ave (GPD campus, 545 NW 8th Ave), Gainesville, FL
projects.notes: Three-story, 24,112 sq ft; groundbreaking Apr 24 2026 (AJAX); completion summer 2027. City news gives a $19 million project cost; the appropriations are higher (likely design, contingency, fit-out). Under the 1989 code the Trust allocation hit the $100,000 cap (artist-designed fence: $80,000 commission + $20,000 maintenance). Equipment/shelving not itemized.

projects.name: Fire Station #3 replacement (NE 8th Ave and Waldo Rd)
projects.funding_note: Capital Improvement Revenue Bond 2026 Series $11,245,000 (FY26 Amendment 3) + $107,474 pro-rata share of the bond fund's $315,398 Non-Departmental line (inferred issuance cost; split is my arithmetic). SSSF surtax 'East Side Fire Station' $5,150,508.07 (FY26 Amendments 1-2).
projects.address: 1025 NE 13th St (near NE 8th Ave and Waldo Rd), Gainesville, FL
projects.notes: 16,773 sq ft, three engine bays, relocating from 900 NE Waldo Rd. Sitework GMP $2,030,207 (Ajax Building Co., Apr 2026). Alachua Chronicle (Jul 20 2026): estimated cost $14 million, completion end of 2027. The City's GCRA page calls it one component of the NE 8th Ave/Waldo Rd revitalization. Part of the $60M 'Safe by Design' trio with the SW Public Safety Center and GPD P&E building. Station is on City land next to the old station, so no land cost.

projects.name: Southwest Public Safety Center (Fire Station #9, Public Works warehouse, community room)
projects.funding_note: Capital Improvement Revenue Bond 2026 Series $20,053,000 + $191,657 pro-rata share of the $315,398 Non-Departmental line (inferred issuance cost). SSSF surtax $7,146,018.48 (FY26 Amendment 2). City also cites Alachua County grant support (amount not in sources read; not included). Earlier 'GFR New Fire Station 9' appropriations ($1,500,000 CIRN 2019; $45,930 FY2015 bond) are not included.
projects.address: 4320 SW 47th Way (near Archer Rd and I-75), Gainesville, FL
projects.notes: 29,754 sq ft hurricane-hardened complex: four-bay fire station, Public Works warehouse, community meeting room; a GPD annex is a future phase. Groundbreaking Jul 31 2026; completion late 2027. City and news give a $22.2M estimated project cost excluding land and design; sitework GMP $3,989,480. Land was bought earlier (outside this total), so land_acquisition is 0 here.

projects.name: Fire Training Facility
projects.funding_note: Capital Improvement Revenue Bond 2026 Series $1,702,000 (FY26 Amendment 3) + $16,267 pro-rata share of the $315,398 Non-Departmental line (inferred issuance cost).
projects.notes: Scope and site not described in sources read. It may be training props or a burn building rather than a regularly occupied building, so public_use is null and building_new is an assumption.

projects.name: GFR Administration/Headquarters and Emergency Operations Center (Catalyst site)
projects.funding_note: SSSF surtax: $1,990,879.15 appropriated in FY26 for 'GFR Administration / Headquarters' (after a $500,000 cut in Amendment 2); the rest assumed from later SSSF years.
projects.notes: $8 million is a planning figure reported for a stand-alone EOC at the Catalyst site (GRU land rights to be negotiated), seen only in a search-engine excerpt of this Main Street Daily News article (HTTP 403 to fetch). FY26 appropriation in https://www.gainesvillefl.gov/files/assets/public/v/2/finance/documents/fy-2026-second-budget-amendment.pdf. fy is an estimate; Catalyst site address not in sources read.

projects.name: Catalyst EOC parking lot and generator site
projects.funding_note: SSSF surtax (per WUFT).
projects.notes: GMP with Ajax Building Co. approved Feb 19 2026 (~$1.79M): site preparation, paving, drainage, utilities, generator site and a future EOC pad with underground stormwater walls. Site work, not a building, so public_use is false.

projects.name: City Hall building systems renewal (chillers, fire alarm, fire suppression, freight elevator)
projects.funding_note: General Capital Projects fund (fund balance and General Fund transfers): chillers x2 $402,823.61; fire alarm $125,000; fire suppression $70,000; freight elevator rehabilitation $300,000 (as amended Jun 4 2026).
projects.address: 200 E University Ave, Gainesville, FL 32601
projects.notes: Building-system replacements in an occupied City building; tests 'major renovation' versus 'ordinary repair and maintenance'. Construction year assumed equal to the appropriation year.

projects.name: City Hall Plaza Refresh
projects.department: Public Works / Wild Spaces Public Places
projects.funding_note: Capital Improvement Revenue Note 2019 '2024 City Hall Plaza Refresh' $1,171,876 (bond proceeds); WSPP $383,042.50. A second $383,042.50 'City Hall Plaza Refresh' line also appears in the WSPP 2023-2032 surtax fund; it may be a duplicate listing and is not added.
projects.address: City Hall Plaza, 200 E University Ave, Gainesville, FL
projects.notes: Downtown civic plaza. At the Apr 9 2026 discussion, rainbow bricks from a reconfigured roadway were described as being reused in a City Hall Plaza remembrance space. Construction year not confirmed; fy is the appropriation year.

projects.name: Historic Thomas Center A and B systems renewal and renovations
projects.department: Public Works / Parks, Recreation & Cultural Affairs
projects.funding_note: General Capital Projects fund $1,590,000 (A: elevator $105,000, fire alarm $520,000, fire suppression $250,000, chiller $180,000; B: elevator $105,000, chiller $180,000, condition assessment $150,000, duct heater $100,000). WSPP surtax 'Thomas Center A Renovations' $300,000 (restricted).
projects.address: 302 NE 6th Ave, Gainesville, FL
projects.notes: Counting the $1.59M of system replacements as repair_maintenance is my judgement. An existing-conditions assessment (R.J. Heisenbottle Architects) is under way and may lead to a larger renovation. Tests the draft's repair-and-maintenance exclusion.

projects.name: Technology Department office space and data center build-out at RTS fleet facility
projects.funding_note: General Capital Projects fund via interfund transfer (FY26 Amendment 3); budget-workshop coverage says it is funded from excess General Fund balance.
projects.notes: Edge case: interior build-out of space where City staff will work, but much of the cost is data-center infrastructure; the equipment share is not itemized, so components are omitted. Reported as ~$2.2M at the first FY27 budget workshop (https://alachuachronicle.com/gainesville-city-commission-faces-7-7-million-budget-deficit-after-first-of-three-budget-workshops-for-fy27).

projects.name: Citywide and Fire Rescue radio replacement
projects.funding_note: General Capital Projects fund: Citywide Radio Replacement $790,848 (FY26 adopted) + Fire Rescue Radio Replacement $175,000.
projects.notes: Equipment purchase, not construction.

projects.name: Wilhelmina Johnson Center renovation
projects.department: Parks, Recreation & Cultural Affairs / Wild Spaces Public Places
projects.funding_note: WSPP surtax. Project page budget $2,047,177.49; the 'WSPP Wilhelmina Johnson Center Building Improvements' appropriation is $2,428,445.57 (as of Mar 5 2026).
projects.address: 321 NW 10th St, Gainesville, FL
projects.notes: Historic 1927 building used by the Cultural Arts Coalition. GMP ~$1.86M with J.E. Decker Construction Group (Feb 19 2026); construction began Apr 2026, completion spring 2027.

projects.name: Morningside Nature Center new nature center building
projects.department: Parks, Recreation & Cultural Affairs / Wild Spaces Public Places
projects.funding_note: WSPP surtax 'WSPP Morningside New Nature Center Building' $6,000,000 ($3.5M in the FY26 adopted budget + $2.5M carried forward).
projects.address: 3540 E University Ave, Gainesville, FL
projects.notes: WSPP page: $6M budget; the master plan for the 416-acre park (Kimley-Horn) is under reconsideration and the nature center building program follows plan adoption. fy is my estimate of construction start.

projects.name: Depot Park Visitors Center
projects.department: Parks, Recreation & Cultural Affairs / Wild Spaces Public Places
projects.funding_note: WSPP surtax: $3,000,000 in the FY26 adopted budget + $91,395 carried forward.
projects.address: Depot Park, SE Depot Ave, Gainesville, FL
projects.notes: Scope (new building or reuse of an existing structure) not described in sources read; building_new is an assumption. WSPP listed it among projects expected to start 2025-2027; fy is an estimate. Depot Park is a 32-acre park at the south edge of downtown.

projects.name: Boulware Springs Nature Park and Historic Waterworks Building renovation
projects.department: Parks, Recreation & Cultural Affairs / Wild Spaces Public Places
projects.funding_note: WSPP surtax plus a $375,000 Florida Department of State, Division of Historical Resources grant (both inside the $4,723,555 budget).
projects.address: 3300 SE 15th St, Gainesville, FL
projects.notes: Renovation of the historic Waterworks Building plus a new trailhead restroom, parking, site lighting, pavilion and landscaping. Redesign from Fall 2026; City says construction could start as early as Fall 2027 (FY2028).

projects.name: T.B. McPherson Recreation Center renovation
projects.department: Parks, Recreation & Cultural Affairs / Wild Spaces Public Places
projects.funding_note: WSPP surtax. WSPP page gives $3.5M for the building renovation; $823,953.75 is appropriated so far ('T.B. McPherson Recreation Complex Improvements 2025').
projects.address: 1717 SE 15th St, Gainesville, FL
projects.notes: Master planning by NV5 ($207,565) under way; design and construction follow. fy is an estimate.

projects.name: Bo Diddley Plaza stage reconstruction
projects.department: Parks, Recreation & Cultural Affairs / Wild Spaces Public Places
projects.funding_note: WSPP surtax $200,000 (FY26 adopted).
projects.address: Bo Diddley Plaza, 111 E University Ave, Gainesville, FL
projects.notes: Structural stabilization of the stage and renovation of the surrounding facility. The WSPP page lists the total budget as TBD pending design, so $200,000 is the current appropriation, not the full cost. Downtown's main civic plaza. fy is an estimate.

projects.name: Bivens Arm Nature Park boardwalk replacement and marsh restoration
projects.department: Parks, Recreation & Cultural Affairs / Wild Spaces Public Places
projects.funding_note: Boardwalk $2,179,460 (WSPP surtax). Marsh restoration $1,331,076 (Tree Mitigation fund and General Capital Projects fund 'Bivens Arm Marsh Restoration' lines).
projects.address: 3650 S Main St, Gainesville, FL
projects.notes: Oelrich Construction; restoration began Jul 2026, completion spring 2027. The marsh work (dredging, planting) is environmental restoration rather than a public-use facility.

projects.name: Sweetwater Recreational Trail Phase 1 (Depot Park to Sweetwater Preserve)
projects.funding_note: WSPP Joint Projects with Alachua County fund ('WSPP Sweetwater Recreation Trail Joint Project with County', $4,107,803.31 for the trail program as of Jun 4 2026).
projects.address: Depot Park to Sweetwater Preserve, Gainesville, FL
projects.notes: 0.8-mile multiuse trail with two pedestrian bridges, a culvert crossing and stormwater work; in design (DRMP; Jones Edmunds). A trail, not a building. fy is an estimate.

projects.name: Hippodrome Theatre historic window replacement
projects.department: Parks, Recreation & Cultural Affairs / Wild Spaces Public Places
projects.funding_note: WSPP contribution $300,000 (WSPP page).
projects.address: 25 SE 2nd Pl, Gainesville, FL
projects.notes: City-owned historic former federal building used as a theatre, downtown. Window replacement is repair rather than renovation. Consultant/contractor TBD; fy is an estimate.

projects.name: 8th & Waldo aquatics center, competition pool and community pool
projects.department: Gainesville Community Reinvestment Area / Wild Spaces Public Places / PRCA
projects.funding_note: Phase 1 funding identified Dec 4 2025: GCRA $10.9M, City WSPP $5M, County WSPP $2.5M (interlocal), City excess fund balance $5M, School Board transfer $5.5M (pending), possible HUD Section 108 loan $7.2M. GCRA line 'Citizens Field and MLK Property Revitalization Project' $7,055,604.50 (FY26 Amendment 2).
projects.address: NE 8th Ave and NE Waldo Rd (Citizens Field / Dwight H. Hunter Pool site), Gainesville, FL
projects.notes: Sum of staff estimates reported Oct 9 2025: competition pool ~$5.5M, aquatics support building ~$2.2M, community pool ~$2.2M. Schematic design (NV5) to finish spring 2027; fy is an estimate. Splitting these items out of the ~$29M Phase 1 is my arithmetic.

projects.name: Citizens Field / 8th & Waldo Phase 1 site work (fields, trails, remediation, stormwater, parking)
projects.department: Gainesville Community Reinvestment Area / Wild Spaces Public Places / Public Works
projects.funding_note: Same Phase 1 funding package as the aquatics center (GCRA, City and County WSPP, fund balance, School Board, possible HUD 108).
projects.address: NE 8th Ave and NE Waldo Rd (Citizens Field site), Gainesville, FL
projects.notes: ~$29M Phase 1 (Dec 4 2025 update) less the ~$9.9M aquatics items = ~$19.1M (my arithmetic): two multipurpose fields, trails, stadium utilities and parking, remediation and stormwater, demolition of the existing pool, senior center pad. The City agreed (Oct 2025) to sell the stadium land to the School Board, which would build the stadium separately (not included). WSPP lists the 8th & Waldo effort at $25M total with $8M WSPP.

projects.name: Martin Luther King Jr. Multipurpose Center renovation
projects.department: Parks, Recreation & Cultural Affairs / Gainesville Community Reinvestment Area
projects.funding_note: Not yet funded (future 8th & Waldo phase). Mix assumed similar to Phase 1 (GCRA, WSPP, other); a general obligation bond was also discussed.
projects.address: NE 8th Ave and NE Waldo Rd (MLK Multipurpose Center), Gainesville, FL
projects.notes: Dec 4 2025 staff estimate ~$12M (Oct 2025 estimate ~$7.9M for a renovation that included a senior component). fy is an estimate.

projects.name: Senior Center at 8th & Waldo
projects.funding_note: Not yet funded; Phase 1 only prepares the building pad. Funding mix assumed (as for the MLK Center).
projects.address: NE 8th Ave and NE Waldo Rd (Citizens Field site), Gainesville, FL
projects.notes: Dec 4 2025 staff estimate ~$9.5M (Oct 2025: ~$9M stand-alone). fy is an estimate.

projects.name: GTEC (Gainesville Technology Entrepreneurship Center) building renovation
projects.funding_note: GCRA tax increment: 'GTEC Capital Improvements' $5,680,511.12 (FY26 Amendment 2). WUFT calls the funding interlocal; FY26 GCRA sources include $3,591,460 of intergovernmental (County) revenue.
projects.address: 2153 SE Hawthorne Rd, Gainesville, FL
projects.notes: GMP $5.15M with D.E. Scorpio Corp. approved Feb 19 2026: structural repairs, flooring, paint, lighting, ADA, drainage, landscaping. City-owned incubator and community building.

projects.name: Porters Neighborhood Community Center ('pink building') renovation
projects.funding_note: GCRA allocation for Porters Neighborhood Improvements.
projects.address: Porters neighborhood, Gainesville, FL (street address not in sources read)
projects.notes: Contract with The Flanagan Companies approved Feb 19 2026 for a building vacant 15+ years; community meeting space; opening targeted for November 2026.

projects.name: The Streatery (SW 1st Ave, SW 2nd St to S Main St)
projects.funding_note: GCRA $2,000,000; Additional 5-cent Local Option Gas Tax $2,085,178.50 (FY26 amended). The gas-tax share is limited to transportation uses.
projects.address: SW 1st Ave between SW 2nd St and S Main St, Gainesville, FL
projects.notes: Downtown street converted to shared public space; GCRA also announced a $500,000 complementary business grant program. Construction year not confirmed; fy is the appropriation year.

projects.name: NE 9th Street milling, resurfacing and safety improvements
projects.funding_note: SSSF surtax 'NE 9th Street - University Ave to NE 23rd Avenue' $5,900,642.94 (after +$1,000,000 in Amendment 2).
projects.address: NE 9th St, E University Ave to NE 23rd Ave, Gainesville, FL
projects.notes: Protected bike lanes, raised intersections, ADA curb ramps; construction Jun 2026 to spring 2027. Amount from https://www.gainesvillefl.gov/files/assets/public/v/2/finance/documents/fy-2026-second-budget-amendment.pdf

projects.name: SW 6th Street resurfacing (Depot Ave to SW 16th Ave), Vision Zero
projects.funding_note: Additional 5-cent Local Option Gas Tax capital projects fund $1,650,000.
projects.address: SW 6th St, Depot Ave to SW 16th Ave, Gainesville, FL
projects.notes: Milling and resurfacing ~2,200 ft, bike lanes, RRFB crossing, curb ramps; construction spring-summer 2026.

projects.name: NE Waldo Rd at NE 3rd Ave intersection improvements
projects.funding_note: FDOT Local Agency Program (LAP) grant $1,484,970 (FY26 Amendment 3).
projects.address: NE Waldo Rd at NE 3rd Ave, Gainesville, FL
projects.notes: Intersection reconfiguration, pedestrian signals, median changes, bike/pedestrian links; construction spring 2027 to summer 2028.

projects.name: Roadway Resurfacing Program (in-house and contracted pavement management)
projects.funding_note: Roadway Resurfacing Program fund: $2,000,000 annual interfund transfer (source fund not stated; presumed General Fund) + $2,514,681.95 fund balance. Uses: in-house $806,307.51; outside contractor $3,708,374.44.
projects.notes: Recurring citywide program; the $2M/yr transfer suggests similar annual amounts in later years (not modeled here).

projects.name: RTS Eastside Bus Transfer Facility and Park-and-Ride
projects.funding_note: Federal Transit Administration grant (news describes it as FTA-funded; procurement carries FTA-required clauses).
projects.address: SE Hawthorne Rd at SE 24th St, Gainesville, FL
projects.notes: Construction bid of $4,308,747 awarded to Blackwater Construction Services on Sep 17 2026 (budget_usd is the construction award only). Program per procurement: at least six bus bays, ~50 park-and-ride spaces, and a building with public and staff restrooms, a passenger waiting area, a training room and two offices, so it is a City building that staff and the public use, but grant-funded.

projects.name: Cedar Grove drainage improvements
projects.funding_note: Stormwater Management Utility fund 'Cedar Grove Stormwater Improvements' $500,000 (FY26 adopted).
projects.address: Cedar Grove Park area, NE 13th Ave and NE 22nd-23rd St, Gainesville, FL
projects.notes: Dry pond, underground storage vault under Cedar Grove Park, conveyance improvements; construction Fall 2026 to spring 2027. Total cost beyond the FY26 appropriation not published.

projects.name: GRU Murphree Water Treatment Plant high service pump station and 5 MG ground storage tank
projects.funding_note: GRU water utility; to be financed over six years with a planned $150M GRU bond issue, without a rate increase (per news).
projects.address: 1600 NE 53rd Ave, Gainesville, FL
projects.notes: Progressive design-build contract (Overland Contracting) approved by the GRU Authority; total not to exceed $55M. Amount and contractor seen only in search-engine excerpts (site returns HTTP 403 to fetch). GRU's capital budget is separate from the City's general government CIP. fy is an estimate.

projects.name: Tree Mitigation Fund land acquisition
projects.funding_note: Tree Mitigation fund (fee-in-lieu payments; coded impact_fee as the closest code): 'Tree Mitigation - Land Acquisition' $8,466,813.75 (FY26 amended).
projects.notes: Land purchases; no construction.
